proof_body:
by
  intro K _ _ x h
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    have hn : Algebra.norm ℤ (0 : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) = 0 := by simp
    exact h.ne_zero hn
  apply Ideal.prime_of_irreducible_absNorm_span hx
  rw [Ideal.absNorm_span_singleton]
  exact (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.1 h).prime.irreducible
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (x : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K), Prime (Algebra.norm ℤ x) → Prime x
